> **Stop condition:** If any step exposes real patient data, loses encrypted data, writes a protected doctor document to an unauthorized Android location, accepts an incorrect trust anchor, silently retries a permanent security failure, or produces an unreviewed destructive migration, stop the run and record a defect. Do not continue to the next scenario.
